partnershipPlan: Patient representatives review the questionnaire translations and the plain-language summary; two board chairs and two coordinators review the feedback report layout; the working group reports progress to the network board each quarter.
socialListening: No social media listening; the network's patient complaints about conflicting plans from 2025 are summarised without identifiers.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: The surgeon said the meeting agreed on an operation first, and the oncologist said chemotherapy first; nobody could show me what was decided.
items.implication: Keep 'who will tell the patient and by when' as a core item.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: If the template just makes the minutes longer, I will scroll past it like I do now.
items.implication: Measure whether the treating team can find the plan, not just whether boxes are filled.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: With sixty cases on the breast list I can prepare the template, or I can chase the scans, not both.
items.implication: Report coordinator time by board size.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: My father told everyone he did not want another operation, and it was never written down.
Composite paraphrase: Show me my board against last month, not against the big teaching hospital.
items.implication: Compare each board with its own past in feedback reports.

summary: Five composite voices on conflicting plans, unread minutes, coordinator workload, preferences and feedback.
